basic_info.description: Welcome to 735 Lawton, a handsome mid-century home in a prime Golden Gate Heights location. It is a sought-after residence boasting a practical floor plan, designed for modern living.  This home features a desirable layout with three bedrooms and two full bathrooms on one level. The large primary suite has a walk-in closet, dual sinks in the ensuite bathroom, and a terrace. Two bedrooms and the second full bathroom complete this level. The main level opens to a large rear deck and terraced yard, features a powder room, and has direct garage access where the washer and dryer are located.  Conveniently located near the N-Judah line, cafes, restaurants, and shops on Irving Street and the 9th Avenue corridor.
